objects.gauge_plane_reading: integrated total heat flux read by the gauges at their plane and at their body temperature; measured
objects.conditional_band: the reading times one minus a reflection range; calculated, conditional on every other frontier term being zero
objects.net_B: net heat that crosses the boundary of the liquid; not identified
objects.demand: mass rate times the enthalpy of the approved profiles; diagnostic, built from the mass

surface_reflection.evidence: measured at room temperature on a quiescent sample; the laboratory explores 0.02 to 0.1 and warns that boiling may raise it; the 60 degree data show negative values

gauge_plane_to_surface.evidence: absorption by cold soot, CO2, H2O and fuel vapour in the dome; at 1 ft a gauge 1.27 cm above the surface read 20 percent more than at the surface, which the laboratory does not transfer to 2 m; for heptane it suspects the readings are low
gauge_plane_to_surface.laboratory_exploration_kind: assumed range for an uncertainty study, declared an open question; not an uncertainty of B

gauge_to_surface_convection.evidence: convection is expected under 10 percent of the total at 2 m, from the literature; not measured here

surface_emission.evidence: unit emissivity at 371 K, the upper estimate of the laboratory (printed 1.1 kW/m2); the gauge runs near that temperature, so part may already be in the reading
surface_emission.derivation: Stefan-Boltzmann at 371 K with unit emissivity

pan_bottom_and_ground_loss.evidence: bottom not insulated, its thermocouple rose about 3 C; 0.2 kW/m2 estimated with an assumed coefficient of 10 W/m2K and 20 C; 1 to 2 kW/m2 called likely from small tests; 2 kW/m2 assumed

rim_conduction.evidence: assumed negligible for a thin side wall and a large pan; not measured

transmission_through_the_liquid.evidence: heptane is semitransparent; a gauge 50 mm below the surface read about 1 kW/m2 in small tests. What is transmitted is absorbed by the glass or the pan and returns to the liquid except for the bottom loss and the storage of those solids

liquid_storage_growth.evidence: one thermocouple 7 mm above the pan bottom, read on a published curve; its total rise is about 10 C with glass and 20 C without
liquid_storage_growth.locator: luketa_2010 Figure 16 p.37 and p.31; depth p.15
liquid_storage_growth.limits: a figure reading of one thermocouple near the edge; glass and steel storage not included; not a bound

feed_temperature.evidence: measured before ignition only; the supply drum is outside the chamber and unused fuel returns to it

mass_rate.uncertainty_note: 1.9 percent is stated for JP8 over 6 min; none is stated for the heptane windows of 2 to 5.5 min

laboratory_balance_for_heptane.statement: the predictions fall within 25 percent of the data for every fuel except heptane; further testing is required to determine whether the gauge readings are low
laboratory_balance_for_heptane.locator: luketa_2010 Table 10 p.30, checked on the page image

between_runs: three runs; pan average 29.6 to 31.7 kW/m2; mass 181.3 to 201.0 g/s
model_error: ideal gas enthalpy without real gas departure, 1.6 percent of the demand
assumption_interval: storage rate read on a figure
uncertainty_kinds.combinable: nothing here is combined into a total: the assumption intervals have no distribution and the gauge terms are not independent of each other

beji_2021_cacc.setup: insulated steel pan 98 mm square and 40 mm deep in a controlled atmosphere cone calorimeter, oxygen below 2 to 5 percent, nominal irradiation 25 and 50 kW/m2 calibrated at the centre of the initial surface
beji_2021_cacc.channels: mass every second, four liquid thermocouples, two gas thermocouples; eight heptane tests
beji_2021_cacc.limits: the average flux on the surface is 5 to 30 percent below nominal as the level drops; the peak rate is 39 to 46 percent below nominal flux over latent heat and the authors suspect vapour accumulation; data shown in figures
beji_2021_cacc.assessment: the best located candidate for the heating question, because the input is imposed and the liquid state is recorded; it does not yet identify the net heat at the surface

sandia_one_foot_tests.assessment: cited without a reference; not located
